title: Nothing distinguishes, ahead of time, a 'leave X be' that fully opens the road (the Vale's and Thornwold's wolves, the toll-men) from one that only avoids the fight while the path stays barred (the barrow-wight, the gray sergeant) — both print the exact same 'holds its ground and lets you' line, so a player can't tell from the text alone whether they can now move on.
